summary: Rang Digitech is a New Jersey-based full-service digital marketing agency (SEO/AEO/GEO, social, paid media, web design and development, analytics) serving startups, SMEs and enterprises, positioned as a 2024-founded unit of the 20+ year Rang Technologies group. It sells both retainer-style marketing work and two packaged AI tools (Google review-response automation and an AI email verifier), and it generates demand through a heavy content program and in-person NJ/NY business networking events. Hiring, reviews and back-office details are thin in public sources, so scale and staffing strain are inferred rather than documented.

facts.fact: Rang Digitech describes itself as a New Jersey-based, US full-service digital marketing agency working with startups, SMEs and enterprises across the USA.

Service lines listed: social media marketing, online advertising, reputation management, content creation, SEO and local SEO, graphic design/animation, website and app development, website maintenance, email marketing and e-commerce.
Its own structured data states foundingDate 2024 and numberOfEmployees 10–50, with only 'New Jersey, NJ' as the address (no street address).
Public contact channels are hello@rangdigitech.com and +1 (732) 333-4674 plus a name/email/phone/message web form; no street address, business hours or online booking calendar are published.
Stated service areas are the United States, India, Canada, United Kingdom and Luxembourg.
The company presents itself as backed by the two-decade legacy of parent Rang Technologies Inc., which it says has been named to Inc.'s fastest-growing list six times and to NJ's Fastest 50.
Leadership page names Jigar Patel as Co-founder and CEO (strategy, operations, business development, talent) and Dilip Patel as Co-founder and President (global operations, finance, accounts, legal).
Company-cited stats on the About page: 98% client satisfaction, 19+ projects actively running, 100+ projects delivered; the home page separately claims 200+ 'happy clients worldwide'.

The site publishes a 5.0 aggregate rating with a reviewCount of 200 inside its own JSON-LD schema, alongside a single named hospital testimonial — these are self-published, not a third-party review platform.

Third-party agency directory DesignRush lists Rang Digitech as founded 2024, 'Under 49' employees, average hourly rate $50/hr, with client industries including healthcare, hospitality, manufacturing, real estate, e-commerce, finance and construction.

Knowledge Center sitemap contains roughly 100 blog posts with dense batch-publishing dates (e.g., six posts dated 2026-10-21, eight dated 2026-09-24, many in May 2026), heavily weighted to AI search/AEO/GEO and AI automation topics.

The company markets two productized AI offerings with their own landing pages: Google Review Response Automation (24/7 auto-replies with sentiment escalation) and an AI Email Verifier (bulk validation, risk detection).

Events page lists 2025–2026 appearances at NJ/NY/VA business events, including MREIA (Clark, NJ), the Small Business Expo at Javits Center, a Jersey City real estate networking event and a Greater Westfield Area Chamber happy hour.
No public job postings were found: SimplyHired returns 'We could not find any Rang Digitech jobs', and the company sitemap has no careers page (common /careers, /about, /services paths return 404).

operations_signals: Lead intake is a single web contact form (name, email, phone, free-text message) plus a phone number and a generic hello@ inbox; no self-serve booking, calendar or quote calculator is offered (https://www.rangdigitech.com/contact-us/).
No business hours, street address or after-hours coverage are published anywhere on the site; the only location given is 'New Jersey' (https://www.rangdigitech.com/).

The FAQ page is live but renders placeholder text ('Service Feature / Description pending...'), suggesting unfinished templated pages managed from a custom admin (https://www.rangdigitech.com/company/faq/).

The testimonials page repeats the same hospital quote twice and includes an unrelated app-style review ('progress tracker'), indicating copy-paste content QA gaps (https://www.rangdigitech.com/company/testimonials/).

Service delivery spans multiple time zones — the company advertises clients in the US, UK, Canada, India and Luxembourg, so response coverage is not limited to NJ business hours (https://www.rangdigitech.com/).

Demand generation depends on a steady cadence of in-person networking events plus a high-volume blog, i.e., manual relationship and content pipeline work rather than inbound-only (https://www.rangdigitech.com/company/events/).
hiring_signals: No careers or jobs page exists on the company domain; the sitemap covers company, expertise, knowledge-center, event, press-release and case-study pages only (https://www.rangdigitech.com/page-sitemap.xml).
SimplyHired shows zero listings under the company name (https://www.simplyhired.com/search?q=Rang+Digitech).

Parent company Rang Technologies runs a group careers page that pitches AI-enabled recruiting and 'offices across 4 countries', recruiting into data/analytics, software/cloud and science/security/business tracks rather than marketing roles (https://rangtech.com/careers/).

No Greenhouse, Lever or Recruitee job board exists for the brand (all returned 404 or generic landing pages), so hiring appears to run through LinkedIn/network recruiting outside public boards (https://jobs.lever.co/rangdigitech).
review_themes: No independent review corpus was found: DesignRush shows the profile without a client rating, SmartCustomer shows 0 reviews, and Trustpilot/Yelp/BBB pages were blocked or empty on access (https://www.designrush.com/agency/profile/rang-digitech).

Published social proof is self-hosted and thin: one hospital-branding testimonial plus duplicates, while the site claims 200+ clients and a 5.0/200-review aggregate in schema markup (https://www.rangdigitech.com/company/testimonials/).
No public complaints about response times, billing or scheduling were located — absence of evidence, not evidence of good service (https://www.rangdigitech.com/company/testimonials/).
tech_footprint: Marketing site runs on Next.js with structured JSON-LD (Organization, ProfessionalService, FAQPage, Service catalog), GA4 (G-7R5D9B36SJ) and a CookieYes consent plus accessibility widget (https://www.rangdigitech.com/).

Content and page data are served from a custom CMS on administration.rangdigitech.com, indicating in-house tooling rather than a standard marketing CMS (https://www.rangdigitech.com/company/about-us/).
Contact form uses a reCAPTCHA placeholder and no CRM, chat or booking widget is visible in page markup — no live chat or scheduling automation detected (https://www.rangdigitech.com/contact-us/).
Social footprint is LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and X; the LinkedIn company page cited in their own schema returned HTTP 403 to automated access (https://www.rangdigitech.com/contact-us/).

They productize AI: dedicated pages for Google review-response automation and AI email verification, both routed to the generic contact form rather than a self-serve signup or demo booking (https://www.rangdigitech.com/solutions/ai-email-verifier/).

Publishing engine is high-volume and bursty — roughly 100 posts, many timestamped in same-day batches — consistent with templated/AI-assisted content production (https://www.rangdigitech.com/post-sitemap.xml).
growth_signals: Company's own stats show a small active book (19+ projects running) against 100+ delivered, i.e., a young agency still building recurring retainers (https://www.rangdigitech.com/company/about-us/).

2025–2026 event calendar spans NJ, NY and VA real-estate, chamber and small-business audiences, suggesting an active local business-development push into real estate and SMB verticals (https://www.rangdigitech.com/company/events/).

Blog cadence jumps sharply in mid/late 2026 with AI-search themes (AEO, GEO, AI assistants, chatbots), tracking a repositioning toward AI-era marketing services (https://www.rangdigitech.com/knowledge-center/blog/).

Launch of packaged AI solution lines (review-response automation, email verifier) alongside traditional agency services points to productization beyond hourly/retainer work (https://www.rangdigitech.com/solutions/google-review-response-automation/).

Positioned as a 2024-founded subsidiary leveraging a 20+ year parent group's brand, awards and back office — growth is partly inherited infrastructure rather than built from scratch (https://www.rangdigitech.com/company/about-us/).
decision_maker: Jigar Patel, Co-Founder and CEO — https://www.rangdigitech.com/company/our-leadership/ ; Dilip Patel, Co-Founder and President — https://www.rangdigitech.com/company/our-leadership/dilip-patel/

inferences.inference: Lead response is likely a bottleneck and a good first agent target.
inferences.reasoning: All inbound goes to one generic form/inbox and a single published phone number, with no booking calendar, chat, or published hours; a 10–50 person agency running content, events and 19+ projects probably routes these manually.

inferences.inference: The team is under real coordination strain despite modest public headcount.
inferences.reasoning: Public signals show ~100 blog posts, multi-state event attendance, two productized AI offerings, multi-country client coverage and a 10–50 employee band; the volume of concurrent activities per published headcount is high, though the mapper's ~89% LinkedIn headcount growth could not be verified (LinkedIn returned 403).

inferences.inference: Offshore/global delivery is part of the operating model.
inferences.reasoning: The company lists India as a served market alongside US/UK/Canada/Luxembourg and markets 'consistent access to external subject matter experts' through the parent group, which reads as blended onshore/offshore staffing rather than a purely local NJ team.

inferences.inference: Piscataway is the group HQ, not necessarily a published Rang Digitech office.
inferences.reasoning: Rang Digitech's site only states 'New Jersey' with no street address, while its parent Rang Technologies is listed in Piscataway, NJ on the same DesignRush directory — the town in this brief is therefore inherited from the parent entity.

inferences.inference: They are a receptive buyer for AI agent tooling, but market automation they do not yet run in their own funnel.
inferences.reasoning: Their blog and two solution pages actively sell AI review-response and email-verification automation, while no chat, booking, CRM or self-serve demo flow is visible on the site itself.

inferences.inference: Content production is probably AI-assisted and lightly edited.
inferences.reasoning: Sitemap timestamps cluster in same-day batches of 6–8 posts, plus duplicated testimonial copy and a placeholder FAQ page — patterns typical of bulk-generated content with limited review.

inferences.inference: Social proof is inflated or at least unverifiable.
inferences.reasoning: The site claims a 5.0 rating with 200 reviews and 200+ clients while simultaneously reporting 100+ projects delivered, and no third-party platform shows a matching review count.

data_gaps: Google Business Profile rating/review count and Maps listing for the Piscataway location could not be retrieved (search providers rate-limited; Google/Maps pages not fetchable).
LinkedIn company page (headcount, ~89% YoY growth, +16 people cited by the mapper) returned HTTP 403 — growth figure is unverified.
Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, Yelp, BBB and Trustpilot all returned 403 or cookie walls; no current or recent job postings could be confirmed.
No street address, business hours, after-hours policy, or named account/ops contacts are published; Rang Digitech's own HQ street address is unknown.
No independent client reviews, quantified case-study results or press coverage could be located; the case-study sitemap exists but listing content was minimal.

Web search tooling was unavailable for most of this session (Exa rate limits, OpenAI quota, missing API keys for Tavily/Brave/Gemini; DuckDuckGo, Brave, Mojeek, Ecosia and Google-via-fetch blocked), so discovery relied on direct site fetches plus a few accessible directories — local news and job-board coverage is likely incomplete.
